epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local deployment setup time from >30 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root to start the full stack.
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint to verify the product can be launched.

slices.title: Create docker-compose configuration and health-check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the container deployment for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose configuration and health-check, so that the full stack can be launched and verified locally.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root, When I run docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully.
Given the running stack, When I access the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a healthy status.
Given the QA pipeline, When deployment tests execute, Then the container health checks pass without failure.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce manual environment configuration errors from >10% to 0%

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce outdated materials in catalog from >10% to 0%
requirements: R1: Implement UI functionality to update existing epidemiological materials.
R2: Implement UI functionality to delete existing epidemiological materials.

slices.title: Implement UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the catalog UI for this epic, I want to add update and delete actions, so that the knowledge base accurately reflects the most current protocols without outdated entries.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog, When a user submits an update, Then the UI sends a PUT request and updates the view.
Given an existing material in the catalog, When a user clicks delete, Then the UI sends a DELETE request and removes it.
Given the QA test suite, When E2E UI tests run for update and delete flows, Then all assertions pass successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce material update/delete turnaround from >10 mins to <1 min

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents from >0 to 0
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated users from accessing the knowledge base catalog.
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in when attempting to create a material.

slices.title: Implement authentication and session mechanism
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to enforce session checks, so that restricted epidemiological protocols are protected from unauthorized access.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog, Then they are blocked from viewing restricted data.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to create a material, Then they are prompted to log in to the system.
Given the automated QA suite, When unauthenticated access attempts are simulated, Then the security assertions pass successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthenticated request success rate from 100% to 0%
